newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares rise at start, new record expected.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares rise at start, new record expected.

text.p: Danish share prices rose in early trade on Monday bolstered by Friday's Dow rise and the strong dollar with dealers said they expected the top-20 KFX index to hit new records yet again.
"We do not expect profit-taking today, so thanks to the Dow and the dollar the index should reach a new record closing high for the tenth consecutive trading day," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had gained 0.75 point to 186.09 at 0735 GMT, having closed an impressive 2.05 point higher on Friday at an all-time end-of-day peak.
